propositions: The `## Success Criteria` and `## Acceptance Criteria` headings encode one concept with a single bar, so Success Criteria should be collapsed into Acceptance Criteria across detectors, prompts, routing, docs, evals, tests, and store tickets.

The split is harmful because `_count_ac_items` counts checklist items only under `## Acceptance Criteria`, so Success Criteria bullets miss the P1 blocking floor and cannot carry the operator-attested tag.
Migration is now affordable because ADR 0053 grandfathers criteria-registry drift at the claim gate, avoiding repo-wide attestation invalidation caused by rotating the regver stamp.
The collapse must be sequenced expand-contract so detectors accept both headings before data moves and the alias is removed last, leaving no un-reviewable window.

Certain sites legitimately retain the string and must be excluded: T2's trial-metrics prose, the dod_uncertifiable wording in verifier prompts and verify_models.py, O-RAN-SC references, and the minified vendor bundle.
Every store ticket carrying a `## Success Criteria` heading was migrated to `## Acceptance Criteria` checklist items, with zero remaining headings and backticked prose mentions left intact.
